text:
marta_csm: Quick check / cohort 'Ignite' enrollments dipped to 5/12 active. Two orgs flagged as fragile renewal signals. Thinking a 2-phase push: 1) "first-success" micro-lab, 2) 20min tailored office hour for admins. Thoughts?

kevin_se: +1. I can prep a tiny one-file Go snippet that wires embeddings -> rerank so teams can run locally in <10m. Will keep env var usage clear.

olivia_pm: Recommend we target feature adoption metric (rerank calls per WAU) and offer a small usage credit for the first 6 orgs that hit it. Also want a one-question pulse inside the lab: "Did you get a correct match? (y/n)" to measure immediate success.

noelle_enable: I can run two office hours slots (09:00 PT & 17:30 CET). I'll build a short RSVP landing page with agenda & quick checklist. Can localize copy for FR/DE too.

opsbot: calendar invite draft created: Ignite cohort micro-lab + office hours  Wed Jun 12 09:00 PT / 17:30 CET. link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/ignite-2024

marta_csm: Kevin, can you also include a security-friendly Docker run option for orgs that need it? A one-command run reduces friction.

kevin_se: Yup. Plan: one-file Go example + Dockerfile + README. Snippet preview (will push full repo by EOD):
```
// go quick example
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "os"
  rd "github.com/redwood/inference"
)
func main(){
  c := rd.NewClient(os.Getenv("RD_KEY"))
  resp, _ := c.Rerank("tiny-rank", "invoice matching", []string{"Inv A","Inv B"})
  fmt.Println(resp)
}
```

olivia_pm: I'll draft the landing page and the email subject A/B test: A) "10m lab: see rerank payback" vs B) "Quick win: better search results in 10m". We should measure RSVP -> lab-run conversion.

noelle_enable: For localization, I'll translate the RSVP content and set the EMEA session reminder at 16:30 UK local. Also will add a short DM template for the two at-risk org admins.

marta_csm: Two orgs: Ignite-Intl (ARR $30k) and Ignite-Docs (ARR $8k). I'll propose the credit only for Ignite-Intl if finance OKs it. Otherwise we use leaderboard badges.

kevin_se: Repo will include a tiny sample dataset, automated test that confirms rerank returned a top match, and instructions for CI if they want to run it automatically.

olivia_pm: Add a 3-question post-session pulse: 1) Did you run the lab? (y/n) 2) Was the result useful? (scale 1-5) 3) Next blocker to production (free text). I'll include the form link in the invite.

noelle_enable: Ops note: I'll schedule invites, add the poll link, and set a follow-up review meeting Fri 10:30 PT to roll up results.

marta_csm: Action recap: Kevin - repo + Docker + test (EOD). Olivia - landing page + email variants + pulse form (tomorrow AM). Noelle - invites + localized copy + review meeting (tomorrow AM). Marta - finance check for credit, tag renewal risk. Reconvene Fri 10:30 PT.

opsbot: thread will auto-archive after 7 days of inactivity.
